messages:
deploy-bot: incident detected: elevated 5xx rate on eu-west1/tokenizer v3.2.1 -> spike ~8% since 10:02 UTC. flagged for fastpatch.

maya: seeing the same in traces. have a hotfix build (v3.2.2-hotfix) that addresses an encoding edge case. need expedited approvals to shorten canary window.

samir: quick question — what's the rollback criteria if this goes sideways? and canary metric checks we want to enforce?

maya: rollback if 5xx > 3% over a 2m rolling window OR p95 latency regresses by >200ms vs baseline. will run smoke+integration tests pre-roll. logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/tokenizer/trace?span=enc-err

deploy-bot: deploy plan created:
```
helm upgrade tokenizer ./charts/tokenizer --set image.tag=v3.2.2-hotfix --namespace eu-west1 --timeout 10m
```

liz: per policy we need 2 approvers from eng + oncall signoff for fastpatch skip of standard 30m canary. @ben-oncall are you available to watch?

ben-oncall: available. can monitor dashboards and pager for 30m. :thumbsup:

release-manager: confirming process: fastpatch allowed if 2 approvers + runbook checklist (smoke tests, changelog, rollback plan). maya pls link PR and smoke results.

maya: PR #5421 linked, changelog entry done. smoke tests: unit + l0 integration passed. plan: canary to 5% traffic, observe 4m, then ramp to 30% if healthy, then to 100% over 6m.

samir: i can approve. watching metrics and traces.

release-manager: approving now. ben-oncall also approved. proceeding with expedited deploy. release note: "hotfix: fix tokenizer encoding edge case causing 5xx on long inputs"

maya: kicking off canary now.

deploy-bot: canary roll started -> 5% of instances updated. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/canaries/2498765432

maya: canary at +4m: p95 stable, errors down to 0.9%. traces show expected behavior on long inputs.

samir: looks clean here, ramp to 30% when ready.

deploy-bot: ramp to 30% initiated... ramp complete. 30% traffic on v3.2.2-hotfix.

ben-oncall: no alerts on logs or pager. monitoring dashboards green.

maya: starting final ramp to 100% over 6m.

deploy-bot: rollout complete. all pods at v3.2.2-hotfix across eu-west1.

release-manager: hotfix marked deployed. please open a brief postmortem with root cause and any follow-ups; assign to maya. also attach any signal thresholds we should add to prevent recurrence.

maya: will file a postmortem and add regression tests + alert rules. will close thread in 1h if no regression. :relieved:
